finite_enumeration.method: all support graphs; the exact Perron--Frobenius necessary prefilter; every independent 3/5 decoration of every surviving support; exact two-place inertia; then canonicalization under S_k

rank_ge_6_nonexistence.application: every member of the stated class is a Lanner diagram, so there is no rank k>=6 member and no compact simplex in H^5+
rank_ge_6_nonexistence.reference: Folke Lanner, On complexes with transitive groups of automorphisms, Lund 11 (1950), 1-71
rank_ge_6_nonexistence.theorem: Lanner's classification: a connected non-elliptic, non-parabolic Coxeter diagram all of whose proper subdiagrams are elliptic has order at most five
